liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Little Red Rooster** (2 other sources): Matt Kelly plays harmonica on Little Red Rooster [3][4]
- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Weir missed every transition through Help, Slipknot and Franklin's while Garcia glared at him; Band drifts slowly and quietly into a fast Help On The Way, spacy through Slipknot [20][23]
- **Franklin's Tower** (2 reviews): Soft rain fell as the band moved from Slipknot into Franklin's; it stopped at song's end and a rainbow appeared over the Greek; Reviewer calls this Franklin's one of the best they've heard, though they mention a Syracuse show [22][31]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Fadeaway sounds menacing, as usual [28]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Jed builds to a huge crescendo from Garcia [28]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Garcia's transitional licks leading from Estimated Prophet into Eyes Of The World are a favorite moment [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-07-14.157189.mtx.seamons.ht142.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: The 7/14 and 7/15 soundboard mixes seemed better than 7/13; clicks removed in Estimated Prophet and Eyes Of The World [1]
- **gd84-07-14.sbd.feguson.354.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 147 min; rated 4.22/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: Garcia's vocals sound distant, typical of 1984-85 recordings, though reviewer rates the jamming among the band's best; Reviewer finds the sound laid back and relaxed, with second-set jams flowing smoothly together; Reviewer feels this recording runs too fast, suggesting a pitch or speed problem [2][21][24][27]
- **gd1984-07-14.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96120.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1984-07-14.136427.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 149 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Sprinkling rain began just as a good second-set jam developed; no one danced down front [20]
- Rain in Berkeley in July is rare; attendees watched the sky in wonder [22]
- Reviewer recalls a hot, salivating crowd and Garcia playing intensely from the start, with Brent strong [29]
- Reviewer found it the least energetic show they'd seen, blaming band fatigue after the previous night's Dark Star [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-07-14.157189.mtx.seamons.ht142.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 [1]
- **gd84-07-14.sbd.feguson.354.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CDR> DAE (cdparanoia)> SHN [2]. Also: Soundboard to unknown generation to CDR, extracted with cdparanoia to SHN, via M. Ferguson; faint analog hiss suggests analog generation [2]
- **gd1984-07-14.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96120.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walkerand Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell XLII-S90) [3]. Also: Tapes from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [3]
- **gd1984-07-14.136427.sbd.GEMS.flac16**: taped by PO and Stucco TINA Holmes; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Sony L-750ESX-HFB Dynamicron EXCELLENT SUPER HIFI VIDEO CASSETTE-> Sony SLO-1800 STEREO VIDEOCASSETTE RECORDER-> Sony PCM-601ESD DIGITAL AUDIO PROCESSOR->… [4]. Also: GEMS source patched with shnid 96120 in Big Railroad Blues, start of Drums, and the whole Saturday Night and Day Job tracks [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gratefuldeadshirt.org: [Grateful Dead Shirt T Shirt Vintage 1984 Greek Theatre UC Berkeley Cal CA GDP L | Grateful Dead Shirt](https://gratefuldeadshirt.org/grateful-dead-shirt-t-shirt-vintage-1984-greek-theatre-uc-berkeley-cal-ca-gdp-l/) [33]
- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-07-15 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-07-15-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [34]
- Fan art by Concertposterauction.com: [Grateful Dead Greek Theatre Berkeley 1984 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1635399/Grateful-Dead-Greek-Theatre-Berkeley-1984-Concert-Poster) [35]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Ticket Ticket Number 0001!! Greek Theatre UC Berkeley July 15 1984 | #4646960196](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-ticket-ticket-number-4646960196) [36]

Reviewer says Weir missed every transition through Help, Slipknot and Franklin's while Garcia glared at him
Garcia's vocals sound distant, typical of 1984-85 recordings, though reviewer rates the jamming among the band's best
Soft rain fell as the band moved from Slipknot into Franklin's; it stopped at song's end and a rainbow appeared over the Greek
Rain in Berkeley in July is rare; attendees watched the sky in wonder
Band drifts slowly and quietly into a fast Help On The Way, spacy through Slipknot
Garcia's transitional licks leading from Estimated Prophet into Eyes Of The World are a favorite moment
Reviewer finds the sound laid back and relaxed, with second-set jams flowing smoothly together
Reviewer feels this recording runs too fast, suggesting a pitch or speed problem
Jed builds to a huge crescendo from Garcia
Fadeaway sounds menacing, as usual
Reviewer recalls a hot, salivating crowd and Garcia playing intensely from the start, with Brent strong
Reviewer calls this Franklin's one of the best they've heard, though they mention a Syracuse show
The 7/14 and 7/15 soundboard mixes seemed better than 7/13; clicks removed in Estimated Prophet and Eyes Of The World
Soundboard to unknown generation to CDR, extracted with cdparanoia to SHN, via M. Ferguson; faint analog hiss suggests analog generation
Jack Straw has its beginning cut
Matt Kelly plays harmonica on Little Red Rooster
Tapes from Joani Walker and Paul Scotton, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones
GEMS source patched with shnid 96120 in Big Railroad Blues, start of Drums, and the whole Saturday Night and Day Job tracks
Matt Kelly plays harmonica on Little Red Rooster
